summary: Hit by a falling coconut while reading under a palm tree
story: Yes, it is me again, and no, I did not go near any giraffes. On August 12 I was reading on a lounger under a palm tree at my hotel in Bentota when a coconut fell and hit me on the left shoulder and the side of my head. The hotel drove me to a clinic, where a doctor examined me, took an X-ray of the shoulder and prescribed painkillers. Nothing was broken. I am claiming the clinic bill and the pharmacy bill. I upgraded to First after Kenya, which now looks like the best decision I made all summer.

documents.name: Clinic bill and report
documents.content: Bentota Bay Medical Centre, August 12, 2026. Patient: Oliver Grant, age 43. Brought in by hotel staff after being struck by a falling coconut. Bruising to the left shoulder and left side of the scalp. No loss of consciousness. Neurological examination normal. Shoulder X-ray: no fracture. No relevant medical history. Advised rest and pain relief. Consultation and X-ray: $380.00, paid.

documents.name: Pharmacy receipt
documents.content: Bentota Pharmacy, August 12, 2026. Prescription pain relief, 10 days: $45.00.

documents.name: Hotel incident note
documents.content: Saffron Beach Hotel, Bentota, August 12, 2026. We confirm that our guest Mr. Grant was struck by a coconut in the garden at about 3 pm today and was driven to the medical centre by our duty manager. The palm has since been harvested.
